idea-plugin.name: Interprocedural Resource Leak Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Flags a resource (JDBC or I/O stream) delegated to a helper method that does NOT guarantee closing it on every path, where the caller never closes it either -- a real interprocedural resource leak (CWE-772), not the simple never-touched-at-all case the platform's own bundled inspection already covers.

Combines TWO techniques this catalog already proved separately: the real, from-scratch Tarjan's SCC algorithm and fixed-point summary computation from Log Injection Companion (interprocedural) with the branch-merging path-sensitive typestate engine from JDBC Double-Close Companion (path-sensitive) -- applied together for the first time in this catalog. A helper method's own "does it close this parameter on every path" summary is itself computed path-sensitively, then propagated across the whole project's call graph via the same SCC-ordered fixed point.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only `Connection`/`Statement`/`PreparedStatement`/ `CallableStatement`/`ResultSet`/`InputStream`/`OutputStream`/ `Reader`/`Writer`; only direct reference arguments (no wrapping expression); a project with more than 3,000 analyzable methods skips analysis entirely.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.

localInspection.displayName: Resource delegated to a method that doesn't guarantee closing it
